description:
Based on the manga series by Hiromitsu Takeda, this romantic comedy is about Takeru Ohyama, a typical perverted teenage boy. His new school doesn't require entrance exams, and it just turned co-ed! Unfortunately, his dreams of a happy high school life are dashed when he finds out the school is much more than it seems. All of the students wield a special item—a Maken—to unleash their magical abilities in duels! Can Takeru find a Maken that works for him? Even while trying to fit in at a new school and dealing with all kinds of girl problems?

(Source: FUNimation)

node.description: The school nurse. She is also the staff-advisor (sort of a "teacher overseer") of Maken-Ki. She was in the Maken-Ki of the school before it became an all-girl's school. She has absurdly huge breasts, possibly the largest of the cast, which attracts the attention of all male students and the envy of girls around her.

Called the strongest maiden in Tenbi by Kodama Himegami and the Vice-President of the student council. She is the childhood friend of Takeru Ooyama and has romantic feelings for him often not caring when her body is revealed in front of him. She shares a room with Takeru Ooyama, Kodama Himegame and Inaho Kushiya.  She wields one of the eight (8) legendary maken, "Murakumo" meaning "Gathering Clouds". Her maken allows her to turn her element into photons around the blade. Murakumo's seal cannot be broken unless it reacts to opponents on par with its power. However, Haruko was able to unleash a little of the maken's power through her anger.

Wields shikigami that follow her around and call her ojou-sama. She needs element to survive, it has not fully been stated what exactly she is. But she has said to herself that she can't leave the tenbi area because the element doesn't flow as fully elsewhere.    ~!Which is why she went out to get a stone full of element so she could travel to the training grounds for the summer vacation.   She stated that Takeru Ohyama is her mortal enemy after she saw the mark on his chest. Although its has yet to be confirmed if she still feels that way as she has kissed him on a few occasions leaving the cast a bit bewildered and annoyed. She can give her shikigami life and bring them into the real world so everyone can see them, giving them a human body in which they can fight with. It is hinted that she has a weakness for cute things, specifically rare and inexpensive stuff animal toys when she forgave the Finians when they tricked her because if she forgave them, she can have the rare king penguin stoffed toy. She is also deathly afraid of ghosts and other supernatural beings. Even becoming scared of a scary story that the story-teller openly admit that he made up the half rest of the story.!~  (Source: Wikipedia)

Self proclaimed fiancée of Takeru Ooyama. She feels strongly for Takeru Ooyama, and although he doesn't remember her much she has decided to wait until he fully does.     Her maken, "Kamudo", takes the shape of a gauntlet that when brandished, greatly increases her strength and speed as demonstrated in chapter 7 when she used it to protect Takeru and the cat (later named Monji) he had saved by breaking a huge rock falling on them and then rushing in front of them to deflect the broken fragments. However, overusing it puts enough stress on her to knock her unconscious.

Ditzy tomboyish principal of Tenbi Academy. She is the one that allowed Takeru, Haruno, Inaho, and Himegami to all live under the same roof. She brandishes incredible power and control over Element as she was able to break through amazingly powerful barriers with her bare hands, thanks to nothing more than her self-proclaimed "fighting spirit". She was in the Maken-Ki of the school before it became an all-girl's school.

She is one of the four students to be selected to show how to duel on the first day. She uses air magic, which she uses shoes to allow her to be in mid-flight. Also she is a member of the Maken-ki club which calms down disturbances in the co-ed school.
A 2nd year student at Tenbi Academy and a member of the disciplinary committee. Her maken is called "Maken Scale Compressor" which allows her to alter the volume and mass of inanimate objects.

She is an American "idol" superstar and is the Venus Unit: Defense Member. She is shown as someone with amazing strength and is well-known through her singing/dancing career as an "idol" as well as a professional wrestler.   Her jingu is an internal-type named "Inverse". Its ability is to "reverse" situations at her will. Her ability is not limited to reversing forces, but could even reverse the will of her opponent (as seen when she reversed Takeru's will to attack him during their battle).  ~! Celia however, is originally male. "Inverse" even gives him the ability to change his gender and physical appearance at will including the reason why his eyes have a heart shaped pupil when a girl. She possesses the ability to become either male or female including characteristics and emotions. Celia is aiming to become a real woman, and is referred to as an okama.!~  -Wikipedia

A perverted high school student. He hates his father believing him to be the reason his mother died. He wields a power known as "blood pointer" which allows him to drain "element" from the people around him through his mouth. He has periodically used this ability throughout the series without knowing it. After the battle with the Venus unit he has begun to undergo training to understand this power and use it. He is the childhood friend of Haruko Ayama.   His maken is known as "Overblow", which lets him cause his opponent's maken to gain incredible power and overflow with element causing it to go out of control and force the user to not be able to use it. However, when his opponent is able to contain the overflow of element or has perfect control over his maken, it would only provide his opponent greater power or even make the maken evolve into something greater.   (Source: Wikipedia)

Furan Takaki is the President of the Student Council Security Division and a senior at Tenbi Academy. She is strict regarding school rules and especially strict towards men, having androphobia due to trauma she experienced in the past. Her Maken is Habaya, a bow that shoots arrows of light - she normally wears her hair in braids and wears glasses, but both come off when she uses it.

She is the secretary of the student council as well as a member of the disciplinary committee. She seems to enjoy Yaoi manga. Her maken is called "Comic Star" which allows her to alter the state of physical objects and allows her to use her imagination to project special effects from Manga into reality.

The Student Council Accountant (treasurer). She is also a ninja. Yuka appears to be carefree most of the time. However, she is very cunning, mostly encouraging activities of the Maken-ki that involve some kind of other work that needs to be done. The most obvious of these actions is the "match" between Venus and Maken-ki, where the players use broomsticks and soap while playing in the pool. She is close friends with Furan and likes to tease her.  Yuka is also the younger sister of Takeru's homeroom teacher Tomiko Amado.
Takeru's homeroom teacher. She also was in the maken-ki of the school before it had to become an all girl's school. Teacher often using "~Ara".

node.description: Twin sisters, one with light hair, the other dark. They have a weakness to cats. Their ability "Time/Space" has the ability to create barriers, including ones small enough to imprison targets or form levitating blocks to walk on. They can reverse the effects of things within the barrier, such as healing wounds and repairing clothes. They are stated as being among the most powerful characters in the series.

Defense Member of the Venus Unit. Appears as a carefree airhead on the outside, but is surprisingly capable (and perverted) on the inside. Her jingu "Aegis" is a Maken that allows her to open gates to other dimensions at will.

Perverted friend of Takeru. He has open feelings for Himegami and is supposedly in her fan club. He often like Takeru peeks on girls when they are in the shower, changing, etc. Much like Takeru, Kengo has a strong sense of justice. He sets Takeru straight, after seeing Inaho cry, figuring out what caused it. He calls Takeru a hypocrite for claiming to want to protect girls, yet making Inaho cry.   His maken can let him exchange places with an item (himself or other people).   (Source: Wikipedia)

Twin sisters, one with light hair, the other dark. They have a weakness to cats. Their ability "Time/Space" has the ability to create barriers, including ones small enough to imprison targets or form levitating blocks to walk on. They can reverse the effects of things within the barrier, such as healing wounds and repairing clothes. They are stated as being among the most powerful characters in the series.
A Chinese who is the Special Attack Member of Venus. Her Maken is Kinben, a two-tailed whip with lightning powers.

Her jingu is "Trident" and can control water (referenced from the trident of Poseidon, God of the Seas in Greek mythology). Her jingu takes the form of a trident and can create and control water, and even manipulate any liquid within its range (even blood or water within a person). She is a very strong character pointed out by Yang Ming when she said that her(Demitora) fighting capabilities are beyond of hers (Yang Ming). Yang Ming also mentions that she only smiles at those whose power she acknowledges, that being Minerva. Her three body sizes are 87-58-85.

Otohime "The Manipulator" Yamato is Ouken's granddaughter and a first year student at Tenbi Academy. Her ability is Doll House which allows her to fashion a voodoo doll to manipulate her opponent. Because of her petite appearance, she is mistaken for being younger than her high school age by Haruko. She performs experiments where she manipulates some creatures and people with a chemical that is similar to Ouken's Soul Collector ability. She is one of the four Shishigami who serves Ouken. Also in the beginning Takeru, Inaho, and herself were the only three that couldn't get a reading of their Maken.  [Source - MAL AkatsukiUlquiora]
One of Himegami's 3 shikigami.
The creator of all the maken in the school. He was in the maken-ki of the school before it had to become an all girl's school.
